contexts.text: The second (style of the Word) is the historical... AC 1139.
In these Books the historicals are exactly such as they appear in the sense of the letter...
Up to  there is nothing historical...

All these things have been connected historically ... like a history of events... The types were fitted together historically; and the better the historicals cohered in a series, the more it was in accordance with their genius.
The historicals there are representative, and were really as they are described; but here significative historicals are made up...
Wherever there occurs any true historical, or made up historical, the mind is held in the letter... AC 1540.
Without the internal sense, in what is the historical different from the historical in any profane writer?
Although it appears in the sense of the letter as rudely historical...
Up to Eber () all things are historically put together... The historicals there are nothing but made up historicals...
The historicals of the Word are not perceived in Heaven, but the things which are signified by the historicals...
In ( and ) it is a middle style between the made up historical and the true historical style...

Even in the (true) historicals there is not a syllable which... does not involve arcana which never appear to those who keep the mind in the historical context. (AC 1183:end.) So, in this chapter, in the sense of the letter, or the historical sense, the names = the peoples who constituted the Ancient Church...
The things (in Jonah) are historical, yet still prophetical...
When the universal things which are abstracted from the literal sense are regarded, the historicals of the literal sense are not attended to.
Up to this point, except in what relates to Eber, the historicals have not been true, but made up. Shown. AC 1315. AC 1343:end. AC 1403.
True historicals begin here... AC 1403.

These things occurred historically as Written, but the historicals are representative, and all the words are significative. AC 1408. AC 1409:3. AC 1409:end. AC 1410. AC 1468. AC 1540. AC 1678:end. AC 2143. AC 2333:end. AC 2607.
These arcana can never be seen, so long as the mind, together with the eye, is held in the historicals...
So the historicals of the Word... are general, natural, nay, material vessels, in which are spiritual and celestial things...
The Lord's words in the true historicals involve the same as they do in the made up historicals...
These are true historicals... AC 1678:end. AC 1709. AC 1783. AC 2015:2. AC 2135. AC 2149:end.
No other historicals are adduced, and in no other order... than such as... would express these arcana.
The true historicals of the Word began... at , up to which point, or rather to Eber, they were made up historicals.
The historicals can never be the Word, because in them, separated from the internal sense, there is no more of what is Divine than in any other historical thing.
(The historical Books of the Word enumerated.) AC 2606.

The profane writers of the most ancient times fitted together their historicals in this way... Therefore all the books of the Church of those times were thus written. Such is the book of Job, and... Solomon's Song, and such were the two Books mentioned by Moses...
So when the historical sense or that of the letter is alone attended to, the internal sense is obliterated.
The World... has supposed that the historicals of the Word are nothing but historicals...
But, regarded in themselves, historicals effect little towards man's amendment; and not anything towards eternal life, for in the other life historicals are given to oblivion.
Unless the historicals were representative of Divine things... they could never be Divinely inspired.
He who reads the Word, especially the historical Word... AC 2333:2.
(Internal) things shine out less from the historicals of the Word than from the propheticals, because the historicals engage the attention... AC 2176:2. AC 2310. AC 6597.
From the historical sense of the letter...
Not according to the historical sense in the following chapter...
That there is (the internal sense) in the historicals, does not so easily appear...

Instead of way they perceive truth, and this in both the historicals and the propheticals of the Word; for the Angels no longer care for historical things, because they are not at all adapted to their ideas... AC 3776.
By the Law were meant all the historicals. Enumerated.

As to the historicals, they are all historically true... except the things in the first chapters of Genesis, which are made up historicals... Although historically true, they have the internal sense...
The historicals... divide the ideas...
(Thus) the Ancient Church had writings both historical and prophetical which were Divine and inspired... AC 2897.

The historicals (of the Ancient Word) were called The Wars of Jehovah... The historicals were written in the prophetic style, and were for the most part made up historicals... Illustrated. AC 9942:5. DSS 103.
They may indeed be of service to the ecclesiastical history of that time...
In so far as they are historicals, there is so little of what is Divine...
The historicals of the Word have this unique characteristic above all other historicals...
If the Word were the Word merely as to the historicals... all the historicals therein would be holy...
(These Knowledges)... such as are with little children who are afterwards regenerated, are in general such as those of the historicals of the Word. Enumerated.

All the historicals of the Word are truths more remote from the Divine doctrinal things themselves, but still are of service to infants and children, that thereby they may be introduced by degrees into the interior doctrinal things of truth and good... while the little children are reading them, and are affected with them from innocence, the Angels who are with them are in a pleasant heavenly state; for they are affected by the Lord with the internal sense, consequently with those things which the historicals represent and signify. It is the heavenly pleasantness of the Angels which inflows, and causes the delight in the little children. In order that there may be this first state... the historicals of the Word have been given...

The mind cannot be instantaneously bent from the historical things... to spiritual ones... for what is historical always adheres, and infills the idea, and yet it must be as it were nothing for the things not historical to be comprehended in a series.

These are the arcana... historically delivered, in order that the Word may be read with delight, even by children and the simple; to the end that while they are in holy delight from the historical sense, the Angels with them may be in the holiness of the internal sense...
There are also historical things which adjoin themselves and illustrate...
Cannot be so evident from the historicals of the Word... because the historicals of the Word... involve arcana of Heaven, and therefore so follow in a series.

Does not appear to those who keep the mind in the historicals... But still these historicals are no otherwise understood by the Angels when they are being read by man... With them the historical sense is turned into a spiritual idea... AC 4989:2.
These things do not appear from their historical sense, but still they are involved... for... the Angels with the man care nothing whatever for the worldly historical things...
Those who suppose the historicals of the Word to be merely worldly historicals...
In the numbers of years there is something more historical than in other numbers... (but) there is nothing historical in the Word which does not involve what is heavenly... AC 4720:2.
When a man comes into... Heaven, he will then know that he retains nothing from the historicals of the Word... AC 5225:end.
Moses represents the Law, or the historical Word. AC 6752. AC 6752:3.
The internal sense... was at the same time to be of service to men, who love historical things more than anything else...
The Angels cannot possibly perceive the historicals themselves.
The historicals of the Word pass into another sense when they are elevated into Heaven...
The internal sense appears less in the historicals than in the propheticals, because the historicals are written in a different style...

The historicals have been given in order that infants and children may thereby be initiated into the reading of the Word; for they are delightful, and seat themselves in their minds, whereby is given them communication with the Heavens... This is the reason why the Word is historical.
All the historicals of the Word... are representative of the celestial and spiritual things of the Lord's Kingdom.
In the external historical sense.
What is historical of the Word cannot enter Heaven. Explained.
Because it is historical; and all that is historical keeps the mind continuously in the external sense, and withdraws it from the internal sense...

The historicals concerning the Creation, etc., are made up historicals, which contain in them heavenly and Divine things... This way [of writing] thence emanated to many outside the Church, who in the same way devised historicals... AC 9942:4. AE 739:5. AE 817:3.
In the historicals not made up, but true...
By the sciences are meant... the historical things of kingdoms, etc.
These Churches are described in the Word, but not historically, except the Israelitish... Church...
One can approach the Lord, and not know any but historical Truths concerning God...
Under Ecclesiastical, see this reference. AE 670:2. Coro 7.
This is why (the Germans) apply themselves especially to the history of letters.
(Title). The History of the Creation delivered by Moses.
Historical things are those which do no harm, provided they are not merely things of memory.
It would take long to narrate that history.
Instead of the history of the Creation there is that of the new creation of man.
The useful sciences (which corroborate and illustrate ideas) are... historical things, etc. DMin 4657.

Historical things hide the spiritual sense more than merely prophetical ones; yet all the historicals of the Word contain a spiritual sense, and still more the prophetical historicals, which are the things which appeared and were said to the prophets... Example(s).
All the historicals of the Word are representative of such things as are of the Church.
